source.inspectionScope: Fresh complete32-line owned toolchain configuration patch read. Both SDK directories update15.2→15.4 while x64 minimum10.15 and arm64 minimum11.0 remain. Existing exact fixed26.5 SDK job configuration and build-libotr target/sysroot consumer were read and reused separately; no fetch/build or SDK availability claim.

text:
commit 86fb21b8d65ee748811433bdd5a65414dc64715e
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Apr 15 12:34:35 2025 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Tue Apr 15 12:34:35 2025 +1200

    Bug 1960503 - Port bug 1959158: Update macOS SDK to 15.4. r=heather
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D245512

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
index 692bcec603c..b0cc5de6af1 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@ macosx64-x64-libotr:
         symbol: TM(libotr)
     worker:
         env:
-            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX15.2.sdk"
+            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX15.4.sdk"
             MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "10.15"
     run:
         arguments: ['macosx64']
@@ -70,7 +70,7 @@ macosx64-aarch64-libotr:
         symbol: TMA64(libotr)
     worker:
         env:
-            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX15.2.sdk"
+            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX15.4.sdk"
             MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "11.0"
     run:
         arguments: ['macosx64-aarch64']
title: Bug 1960503 - Port bug 1959158: Update macOS SDK to 15.4. r=heather
